title: A point picked on an open graph keeps its value bar off the line being shaped
goal: Clicking a point on an open value graph opens the small value bar (name, value, Reset) above the point, and on a graph that lands on top of the curve leaving the point, hiding the very segment a person is about to shape. The bar should sit where it covers neither the point nor its line.
notes: Seen 2026-10-14 in Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/bar-easing-sets-points-and-segments-walk.json (walk ok): /tmp/photonz-playtest/bar-easing-sets-points-and-segments-walk/2-mixed-sc.png and 3-both-eased-sc.png, real captures. After a Shift-click on Key Scale 2 (middle point, 3 keys 1s/~3s/4s), the key bar (Scale 200% Reset) sits at about x 750-970, y 930-1020 (display pts at 2000 wide) and the second segment rises from the point at (860,1037) up under it. Mock video-animate.html: the bar opens above the key, never over it; UX rule never cover what is being manipulated.
acceptance: With a graph open, picking a middle point shows its value bar with no part of the curve or its handles under it
The bar still opens above a key on a closed row, as it does today
A walk picks a point on an open graph at Next defaults and photographs the bar clear of the line

log.note: Reproduced 2026-10-15 with Scripts/playtest.sh bar-easing-sets-points-and-segments-walk: 2-mixed-sc.png showed the Scale 200% bar over the segment rising from Key Scale 2. Fix: KeyValuesPlacement.frame(...clearOf:) in PhotonzCore tries spots along above, then below, then beside the key and takes the first that covers no curve or handle (least covered otherwise); KeyLaneView reports the open graph's segments, held lines and shown handles measured from the anchored key; the expectKeyValues walk step now fails if the bar covers any of it. Looked at 1-rising, 2-valley, 3-closed-row captures: clear on the graph, centred above on the shut row. First Scripts/test.sh run reported 1 issue with the output not kept; rerun passed (exit 0, 13245 tests), so it was not reproduced.
